beforeDevCommand.script: ping 127.0.0.1 -n 4 > NUL && start /B poetry run python backend/server.py && poetry run python frontend/main.py

beforeBuildCommand.script: poetry run pyinstaller --noconfirm --distpath src-tauri-frontend frontend.spec && poetry run pyinstaller --noconfirm --distpath src-tauri-backend backend.spec &&  move src-tauri-frontend\frontend src-tauri && move src-tauri\frontend\frontend.exe src-tauri\frontend\frontend-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe && move src-tauri-backend\rescuebox src-tauri && move src-tauri\rescuebox src-tauri\backend && move src-tauri\backend\rescuebox.exe src-tauri\backend\rescuebox-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe
